Overview

The hidden cost of Blockchain & Digital Trust for Retail & Consumer Goods is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on commerce & POS estates, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. For Retail & Consumer Goods, the design tension is specific — fresh waste on one side, GDPR / privacy regimes on the other, and a control environment that must survive both internal audit and external inspection. We build for that tension explicitly rather than discovering it at gate review.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
What usually goes wrong, and the specific guard in this build:

items: On-chain PII
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.
Key fragility
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
Ledger worship
The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
